patterns.note: A fixed-width, full-height left sidebar with navigation and branding persists across all scroll depths, contrasting with a full-viewport-height main content area that animates vertically.
Main content sections transition with a full-viewport vertical slide-up animation, where each new section pushes the previous one off-screen, creating a sequential, immersive storytelling experience.

The hero section features a large numerical counter that dynamically changes its value (e.g., from '195' to '365') upon initial page load or first scroll interaction, creating an immediate sense of dynamism.
High-impact, condensed display typography is used for all major headings, often in all caps, creating a bold and assertive visual voice.
A vibrant, almost neon green (#00cf78) serves as the primary accent and background for the sticky navigation, providing high contrast against a dark, almost black background.
Each major content block is designed to occupy the full viewport height, functioning as a distinct 'slide' in a vertical presentation, guiding the user through a narrative.

technique_notes: The site employs a sophisticated scroll-driven animation system, likely using GSAP ScrollTrigger or Locomotive Scroll, to create a full-screen vertical section reveal. As the user scrolls, each content block smoothly slides into the viewport, replacing the previous one, giving the impression of a dynamic presentation.
A fixed, full-height sidebar provides persistent navigation and branding, maintaining its position while the main content area scrolls independently.
The hero section includes a numerical counter animation that visually transforms its value upon initial page load or scroll, adding an immediate interactive element.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, condensed headings (~6-8x body) with a strong, bold character, complemented by smaller, legible body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (e.g., buttons and input fields have a slight curve, not sharp corners).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous padding around elements and full-viewport-height sections creating distinct visual breaks.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the immersive, full-screen vertical scrolling experience that acts like a dynamic presentation, combined with the bold, condensed typography and the fixed, vibrant green navigation sidebar. The playful, slightly grungy hand-drawn elements also add character, making the site feel unique and engaging.
